recordedWith: the browser's own cut in voni/src/lib/voice/session-lifecycle.test.ts (playMs(14 * CAPTION_MS_PER_CHAR) -> 'I'd handle booking')
comment: One behavioural table for the unheard-tail barge-in recovery, read by BOTH the browser test (voni/src/lib/voice/barge-in-recovery.test.ts) and the phone test (telephony-bot/test_barge_in_recovery.py). heard = the words whose start played; rest = the exact unheard tail from the last heard word (the browser keeps it as a one-word overlap because the cut landed mid-word); instruction = what the agent is told to say next, or null when the tail is too short to be worth resuming (RESUME_MIN_WORDS).

cases.name: a filler barge-in resumes the exact unheard tail from the last heard word
cases.line: I'd handle booking and reminders for you
cases.instruction: The caller only said "Okaay so" while you were speaking; it wasn't a request to stop. Finish your sentence: say exactly this and nothing else, word for word: "booking and reminders for you"

cases.name: a noise with no caller words still resumes the unheard tail
cases.line: I'd handle booking and reminders for you
cases.instruction: A noise on the caller's side cut you off; they didn't say anything. Finish your sentence: say exactly this and nothing else, word for word: "booking and reminders for you"

cases.name: a cut after the last word has nothing left unheard
a tail of three words or fewer is not worth resuming
hearing only the first word keeps the whole line, heard word included
cases.line: I'd handle booking and reminders for you
cases.rest: I'd handle booking and reminders for you
cases.instruction: The caller only said "uh-huh" while you were speaking; it wasn't a request to stop. Finish your sentence: say exactly this and nothing else, word for word: "I'd handle booking and reminders for you"

cases.name: a line that played in full leaves only the overlap word, never a restart
